reviews.comment:
Costo benéfico recomiendo aca 100% soy un socio nuevo y hoy fui aquí, los playeros muy amables, seguridad muy amable ya que no tenía donde estacionar y me banco unos segundos mal estacionado mientras consultaba algo en las oficinas, la gente del full impecable muy buen servicio.
De yapa aproveche el lavadero, la verdad que jamás llevo mi auto al lavadero pero bueno por falta de tiempo lo hice allí, no quedé muy conforme pero entiendo el concepto de que es algo para despachar rápido y al paso, y aclaro que yo es porque soy muy detallista con el vehículo cualquier otra persona estoy seguro que está conforme 100%.
En fin volvería y volveré a seguir disfrutando de las instalaciones.
Si quieren una opinión constructivas del sector lavadero, falta detallar algunas partes donde la máquina que limpia no llega ej: atrás de los espejos, y algunas partes del paragolpe lo que más flojo me pareció es la limpieza del interior pero entiendo o quiero creer que le dan una "pasadita" y ya está. Para un lavado mantenimiento va como piña si volves de las vacaciones vas a encontrar detalles jaja.

(Translated by Google)
I highly recommend this place, it's great value for money. I'm a new member and went here today. The attendants were very friendly, and the security was very helpful since I couldn't find parking and they put up with me being badly parked for a few seconds while I checked something in the offices. The full service staff were impeccable and provided excellent service.
As a bonus, I took advantage of the car wash. I never usually take my car to a car wash, but I had no time and went there. I wasn't completely satisfied, but I understand the concept of it being a quick and easy service. I should clarify that I'm very particular about my car; I'm sure anyone else would be 100% satisfied.

Anyway, I would come back and will continue to enjoy the facilities. If you want constructive feedback on the car wash area, there are some areas the cleaning machine can't reach, for example, behind the mirrors and some parts of the bumper. The interior cleaning was the weakest point, but I understand, or want to believe, that they just give it a quick once-over. For a routine wash and maintenance, it's great, but if you come back from vacation you'll find some details, haha.
